name: Extract Article with Diffbot
description: Extract clean article text, metadata, tags, and images from any URL using Diffbot's Article API. Handles multi-page concatenation, NLP analysis, and comment extraction automatically.

url.description: URL of the article/blog post to extract

discussion.description: Set false to disable comment extraction

maxTags.description: Maximum number of auto-generated tags to return

fields.description: Optional fields to return: links, extlinks, meta, querystring, breadcrumb, quotes (comma-separated)

steps.name: Build query parameters for Diffbot API
